source.probe: x_sigma=0 and sigma/noise index uniform over the 1000 diffusion levels
source.parameters: independent default initializations of the paper's iDDPM U-Net

estimator.stratification: each consecutive block of 1000 independent networks assigns every diffusion timestep exactly once

acceptance.definition: accumulate vector outer products, never scalar squares
acceptance.independent_checker: Torch and NumPy eigenspectra agree within 1e-8 relative error
acceptance.negative_control: fixed random directions are rejected as eigenvectors
acceptance.uncertainty: checkpoint overlaps, split-half vector/subspace overlaps, and block-bootstrap eigenvalue intervals are reported
acceptance.exit_behavior: nonzero on any structural or control failure

scientific_verdict: No generation-preference verdict is allowed until actual iDDPM training and sampling use the committed directions.
